# Eshan Roy (eshanized)

> Founder & CEO, Systems Engineer. Technology entrepreneur building operating systems, autonomous AI engineering systems, developer infrastructure and open-source software.

Eshan Roy, known professionally as eshanized, is a technology entrepreneur, systems engineer, and Founder & CEO of Tonmoy Infrastructure & Vision. His work focuses on building operating systems, autonomous AI engineering systems, developer infrastructure, and open-source software.

## Canonical Identity
- Legal/Public Name: Eshan Roy
- Professional Alias: eshanized
- Primary Title: Founder & CEO, Systems Engineer
- Organization: Tonmoy Infrastructure & Vision (https://tonmoyinfrastructure.org)
- Canonical Website: https://eshanized.is-a.dev/

## Core Engineering Focus
- Operating systems engineering
- Autonomous AI engineering systems
- Developer infrastructure
- Open-source software
- Distributed systems

## Major Projects
- [Snigdha OS](https://github.com/Snigdha-OS): Arch-based Linux distribution ecosystem focused on desktop coherence, system tooling, package management, and developer utilities.
- [M31A](https://m31a.tonmoyinfrastructure.org): Autonomous coding-agent runtime with deterministic policy gates and verifiable execution.
- [Polaris](https://crates.io/crates/eshanized-polaris): Rust-native distributed task orchestration engine featuring cluster state consensus and procedural macros.
- [Veda](https://github.com/TIVerse/veda-rs): High-performance persistent key-value engine in Rust.
- [Dep Insight](https://github.com/TIVerse/dep-insight): Static dependency vulnerability and license topology analyzer.
- [MultiGit](https://github.com/TIVerse/multigit): Multi-repository orchestration and synchronizer for polyrepo architectures.
